{{Quote|Daddy loves his Kobarian swamp dogs almost as much as he loves me.|Pelf Pachoola|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
'''Pelf Pachoola''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] who was the [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] [[Fume Pachoola]]. She was spoiled and prone to emotional breakdowns, and [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] was arranged between her and a [[Pelf Pachoola's fiancé|fiancé]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Pelf and Fume, accompanied by their [[Kobarian swamp dog]]s [[Higgs]] and [[Twiggs]], traveled aboard the [[C-One liner|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'' to attend Pachoola's wedding at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]].

Aboard, the Pachoolas met [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], the leader of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] who was impersonating a passenger while scoping out potential targets to kidnap and hold for ransom. At a [[Diet/Legends|dinner]], Ohnaka became [[Alcohol/Legends|drunk]], going on to divulge his plans to the other passengers and amusing Pelf with his antics, which she recounted to the oblivious, hung-over [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. Later, at lunch, Pachoola and Ohnaka witnessed a surprise exhibiton of [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Saffa paintings]], after which the Wroonian entered into a hysteric tirade of wailing and crying after she witnessed an apprentice [[Foodstuff/Legends|pastry]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] wearing the same [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] as her bridesmaids.

Pachoola's outbursts eventually led Ohnaka to decide against selecting her as a kidnapping target, although, when the pirates finally launched their operation, the young woman began panicking and entered the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], with Ohnaka being forced to eject the craft from the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] with her among the hostages. However, Pelf's fiancé refused to pay the ransom for her, and the pirate gang ended up forcing a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to transport the Pachoolas off their base world [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].

==Biography==
===Day 1===
{{Quote|The boys are just glad to see you, Mr. Rosada! And so am I! You were so funny last night! You kept pinching my cheeks and saying I was precious!|Pelf Pachoola, to Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
Pelf Pachoola was the young [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of [[Fume Pachoola]], an [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] who had inherited a fortune from his [[Fume Pachoola's grandfather|grandfather]].<ref name="Insider144" /> At one point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HondoDate">{{HondoOhnakaScoreDate}}</ref> [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] was arranged between Pelf and a [[Pelf Pachoola's fiancé|fiancé]]. The Pachoolas subsequently boarded the ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', a [[Salin Excursions]] [[C-One liner|luxury liner]] offering cruises along<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> from [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]],<ref name="Insider144" /> a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]],<ref name="Xim Week">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> to<ref name="Insider144" /> the planet<ref name="Legacy41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref> [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]]<ref name="Insider144" /> of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]],<ref name="EAOC Botajef">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef system]]</ref> in order to attend Pelf's wedding ceremony at the latter world. Accompanying the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] pair were [[Higgs]] and [[Twiggs]], Fume's extremely expensive pair of [[Kobarian swamp dog]]s, with Pachoola's [[Parent/Legends|father]] having gifted her the two show [[Dog/Legends|dogs]] as a wedding present and part of her dowry.<ref name="Insider144" />

[[File:OhnakaSalinMarinerHologram-Insider144.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Pelf Pachoola became a kidnapping target by Hondo Ohnaka while traveling aboard the ''Salin Mariner'' (Ohnaka and the ''Salin Mariner'' pictured).]]
One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], while Pelf and Fume were having [[Diet/Legends|dinner]] with a few other first-class passengers on the ''Salin Mariner''{{'s}} promenade deck, they were joined by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] leader of a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] who was posing as another passenger&mdash;a shipping magnate named Rondo Rosada&mdash;in order to scope out potential targets to kidnap and hold for ransom. As he sat down at the table with Pachoolas and others, Ohnaka was bit in the [[Limb/Legends|foot]] by a Kobarian [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] dog, leading to Pachoola introducing him to the animals. Later, when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] was feeling confused by the abundance of [[Fork/Legends|forks]] present on their table, he observed the young Wroonian to see which utensil she would pick up; however, none of the people at their table was at the time showing any interest in eating.<ref name="Insider144" />

Over the course of the evening, Ohnaka became [[Alcohol/Legends|drunk]] on [[Vasarian brandy]], going on to repeatedly pinch Pachoola in the cheeks and telling her she was precious. Announcing that he adored his companions at the table, the Weequay also divulged his plans to kidnap Pachoola and the others and hold them for ransom. Finally, the pirate also ordered the band of [[Musician/Legends|musicians]] performing for them to instead play [[scrak]] and [[Smazzo/Legends|smazzo]], proceeding to surprise Pachoola with his dancing skills.<ref name="Insider144" />

===Day 2===
====Uncomfortable conversations====
{{Quote|Pelf, look at this painting here. Tell me what you see, my delectable azure cupcake.''"<br />"''Um, it's red? Red and green and squiggly! Is it a deek-pa-neek out for a swim?|Hondo Ohnaka and Pelf Pachoola|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
[[File:OhnakaSalinMariner-Insider144.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Pachoola engaged in several conversations with Ohnaka (pictured), who was impersonating the shipping magnate Rondo Rosada.]]
On the following morning, Pachoola and Higgs and Twiggs were present on the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner's]] [[Vista Walk]], where they encountered a hung-over Ohnaka. The young woman proceeded to recount to the pirate his antics of the previous night, of which he had no recollection. During their meeting, Higgs swallowed Ohnaka's [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]&mdash;which he was using to stay in touch with his pirate subordinates and coordinate their upcoming kidnapping operation. Ohnaka attempted to retrieve the device by hitting the creature's torso, leading to Pachoola admonishing him and then excusing herself to pick out party [[Foodstuff/Legends|appetizers]].<ref name="Insider144" />

Later, at lunch, Pelf and Fume argued about invitations. After Ohnaka's late arrival at the meal, the ''Salin Mariner''{{'s}} attendants, acting on the Weequay's lie on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] passenger questionnaire about being an expert on the [[Saffa paintings|paintings]]<ref name="Insider144" /> of the [[Saffa (species)|Saffa]]<ref name="Heir">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="First Contact">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref> brought in a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] exhibit of those artworks, eliciting a brief comment from Pachoola about their aesthetic value. When the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] entrepreneur [[Sibs Monchan]] subsequently began mockingly questioning Ohnaka about the [[Painting/Legends|paintings]], the pirate turned to the Wroonian woman and asked for her interpretation of a specific painting. After Pachoola ventured a guess that the art piece depicted a [[deek-pa-neek]] going for a swim, Ohnaka presented her answer to Monchan as an example of "artistic sensitivity," in contrast to the factual questions posed by the entrepreneur.<ref name="Insider144" />

====Distress over dress====
{{Quote|NO, IT WILL NOT BE ALRIGHT! A PASTRY CHEF ON A THIRD-RATE LINER IS WEARING THE SAME DRESS AS MY BRIDESMAIDS! ''[&hellip;]'' MAKE IT STOP, DADDY! MAKE HER GO AWAY FOREVER!|Pelf Pachoola|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
Pachoola then noticed the arrival of the starship's apprentice pastry [[Chef/Legends|chef]], who was bringing a dessert cart into the room. Immediately registering the bright [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] the other woman was wearing, Pachoola began wailing and crying, claiming that the garment was the same as that of her bridesmaids, which she found unacceptable due to the perceived inferior social status of the apprentice.<ref name="Insider144" />

[[File:HondoOutpost-BFR.png|thumb|right|300px|The thought of holding Pelf Pachoola hostage at his pirate base on Florrum (pictured) made Hondo Ohnaka decide against kidnapping her.]]
While Pachoola was still being upset, Ohnaka offered to take the swamp dogs out for a walk. Waiting for a steward to bring him an emetic he had asked for in order to retrieve his comlink, Ohnaka imagined the Wroonian shrieking while [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in a cell at the pirates' [[Hondo's complex/Legends|base]] on<ref name="Insider144" /> the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]<ref name="EAOC Florrum">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Florrum system/Legends|Florrum system]]</ref> world [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|locations|florrum|Florrum}}</ref> As that mere thought intensified the symptoms of his hangover, the Weequay decided against kidnapping the younger Pachoola. When Ohnaka finally managed to feed the swamp dogs the emetic, he was taken aback by the messiness and intense smell of their vomited [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]] contents, prompting him to rhetorically inquire as to what the animals' owners were feeding them.<ref name="Insider144" />

===Day 3===
{{Quote|I want off this ship! Women and children first!|Pelf Pachoola|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
[[File:OhnakaFreighter-Insider144.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Ohnaka observes a freighter carrying Pachoola away from the pirate base.]]
The following day, Pachoola had a number of emotional breakdowns, which Ohnaka, enjoying the final planned day of his stay aboard the ''Salin Mariner'', did not let irritate him. When Ohnaka's pirates finally staged their diversion by shooting a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at the liner, their leader instructed his cruise companions to follow him to the craft's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Pachoola reacted with panic, grabbing and holding onto Ohnaka's arm, while Higgs and Twiggs, sensing her worried state, began to howl. After Monchan and the [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] real-estate mogul [[Usk Haffa]] refused to follow Ohnaka into the escape pod, preferring instead to head to the ship's safe room, the pirate attempted to persuade them to take Pachoola with them. Monchan, however, refused, proclaiming her to be Ohnaka's "problem." The panicking Wroonian then scrambled into the pod before the pirate could stop her. Ignoring Ohnaka's attempts to have her exit the craft, she also yelled for her father not to leave her, after which the older Wroonian also climbed into the pod. After the escape pod ejected from the ''Salin Mariner'', Pachoola noted her concern about the swamp dogs falling [[Spacesickness/Legends|space-sick]], an idea that caused Ohnaka a measure of chagrin.<ref name="Insider144" />

When the pirates delivered their hostages to Florrum and made their ransom demands, Pachoola's fiancé let them know that they "could keep her," while her father preferred [[Death/Legends|dying]] there instead of paying them. As a result, upon a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] delivery to Florrum of a shipment of [[Grog/Legends|grog]] that constituted the ransom for the businessman [[Dix Tarfait]], the pirates ordered the captain&mdash;over his complaints and at [[Weapon/Legends|gunpoint]]&mdash;to take the Pachoolas and their swamp dogs offworld with him, a request that was complied with.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm heading for the safe room at Junction Besh.''" [&hellip;]<br />"''You're right&mdash;take Miss Pachoola with you.''"<br />"''That screeching lunatic? She's your problem.|Sibs Monchan and Hondo Ohnaka|<ref name="Insider144" />}}
Pelf Pechoola was a blue-skinned Wroonian woman. She was a spoiled daughter of a nobleman who despised the very idea of working for a living, and she considered unacceptable the fact that an apprentice pastry chef working aboard what she described as a "third-rate liner" was wearing the same dress as her bridesmaids. Pachoola was emotionally expressive, sometimes displaying naiveté, for example, when she failed to recognize the danger in Hondo Ohnaka's drunken comments about kidnapping her and holding her for ransom. She referred to her inherited Kobarian swamp dogs Higgs and Twiggs as "Higgsie" and "Twiggsie," and the animals at times reacted to her emotional state. When Hondo Ohnaka repeatedly hit Higgs in order to try and retrieve the comlink that the creature had swallowed, the Wroonian eventually admonished the Weequay for it.<ref name="Insider144" />

[[File:Hondo-SWE.png|thumb|right|300px|Pelf Pachoola grew to enjoy the company of Hondo Ohnaka (pictured), who in turn addressed her in a patronizing manner and initially intended to hold her for ransom.]]
Pachoola enjoyed the company of Hondo Ohnaka, who, unbeknownst to her, was planning to kidnap her and hold her for ransom. She was glad to meet him on the second day he was aboard the ''Salin Mariner'', and she found his antics while being drunk amusing as well as appreciating his dancing skills. She noted to Ohnaka that her fiancé would not appreciate him telling her his intention to kidnap her, although she stated that in a non-serious tone. In turn, Ohnaka, while eventually growing to dislike Pachoola, consistently addressed her in a patronizing manner, calling her his "little blue [[Dumpling/Legends|dumpling]]," "delectable azure [[Cupcake/Legends|cupcake]]," or "[[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]] treasure," as well as referring to her "pretty cerulean head."<ref name="Insider144" />

Pachoola was prone to emotional breakdowns. Upon witnessing the dress of the ''Salin Mariner''{{'s}} apprentice pastry chef, she flew into a hysteric, prolonged tirade of wailing and crying, demanding that her father rectify the situation. Eventually, Ohnaka found her behavior to be highly annoying, and Sibs Monchan held a similar opinion, referring to her as a "screeching lunatic." Upon confronted with the reality of the liner being under attack, Pachoola entered a state of terror and panic, expressing demands that others prioritize safely transporting her off the ship and also that her father not leave her side.<ref name="Insider144" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pelf Pachoola appeared in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Insider144Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref>
